dz: 哈德良皇帝在尼罗河上建立安提诺欧波利斯城以纪念他的同伴安提诺斯,在罗马埃及建立了一个新的希腊人基金会.
de: Emperor Hadrian establishes the city of Antinoöpolis on the Nile in honour of his companion Antinous, creating a new Hellenizing foundation in Roman Egypt.
